issue.title: Clone SDD sidecars from a local primary checkout before the remote
issue.description: While implementing lazy document sidecar materialization, the approved plan accepted the current cost: ensure_sdd_kind_clone -> ensure_sidecar_sdd_clone clones missing sidecar roles from the recorded remote URL even when a matching local primary checkout already has that sidecar clone. The first @research ref in a fresh workspace therefore pays a full network clone on the launch path, and the same source choice affects sase repo path <role> --ensure plus existing plans/beads workspace prep. Scope: teach sidecar materialization to prefer a verified matching local primary checkout as the clone source or fallback, preserve remote URL normalization and strict failure diagnostics, and cover plans, beads, and custom document sidecars without weakening workspace isolation.
